tools.name: pull_content
tools.description: Pull licensed creator content from a specific pocket by ID. Use this tool when an AI agent needs to retrieve verified, provenance-tracked content for generation, RAG, and inference use. Training use requires a separate training license — see training_use in the agreement terms. Do NOT use for browsi

tools.name: search_pockets
tools.description: Search the Meta-Stamp Pockets catalog by keyword, creator email, or content category. Use this tool when an AI agent needs to discover available licensed content before pulling it. Ideal for finding relevant pockets when the agent knows what topic or creator it needs but not the specific pocket ID.

tools.name: list_pockets
tools.description: List all available content pockets in the Meta-Stamp Pockets catalog, optionally filtered by creator. Use this tool when an AI agent needs to browse the full catalog or see everything available from a specific creator. Prefer search_pockets when looking for specific topics. Does NOT retrieve content

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pull_content, search_pockets · Private data: pull_content, search_pockets, list_pockets · Public sink: search_pockets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pull_content, search_pockets · Private data: pull_content, search_pockets, list_pockets · Public sink: search_pockets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
